fieldValues.title: Each run ends with a lesson pass into a new package version
fieldValues.move: Close every run with a review stage that turns the maintainer's corrections and new rules into proposed changes to the package (house rules, stage guidance, types, vocabularies), which a person accepts into a new package version; before release, re-run that version on the earlier sources and diff the result.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not decide which lessons are worth keeping; a person still judges. A re-run diff shows change, not whether the change is better.
fieldValues.falsifier: After three meetings under the loop, the maintainer is still making the same kind of correction on each new meeting, or accepted package changes make the re-run of an earlier meeting worse by the maintainer's reading.
fieldValues.return_when: Package versions change less often than meetings arrive for three cycles: the practice has settled and the review can run less often.
